components.name: Citations
components.doc: Groups an answer with its sources. Inside it, `<Citation>` is a numbered chip that opens a card with the source, and `<CitationSources>` lists them all. The parts share one highlight: pointing at a chip marks its row in the list, and pointing at a row lights up its chips.

components.name: Citation
components.doc: A numbered chip for the middle of a sentence. Hover, focus plus Enter, or a tap opens a card with the source; a click pins it open.

components.name: CitationSources
components.doc: The numbered list of every source. One highlight glides to the row under the pointer or keyboard focus, or to the source whose chip is active.

members.name: id
members.doc: Stable id that `<Citation source>` refers to.

members.name: title
members.doc: Title of the page or document.

members.name: site
members.doc: Name of the site. Defaults to the host of `url`.

members.name: snippet
members.doc: Short passage or summary that supports the claim.

members.name: date
members.doc: Publication date or year, as it should be shown.

members.name: sources
members.doc: Every source that can be cited, in the order they are numbered.

members.name: children
members.doc: The text with `<Citation>` chips inside it, and usually a `<CitationSources>` list after it.

members.name: onActiveIdChange
members.doc: Called when hover, focus or an open card changes the highlighted source.

members.name: className
members.doc: Class name added to the root element.

members.name: source
members.doc: Id of the source this chip cites.

members.name: className
members.doc: Class name added to the chip.

members.name: className
members.doc: Class name added to the list wrapper.
